TITLE: Shack City

SUMMARY: The City of Johannesburg is actively building shacks for millions of Rands. According to the City’s Guidelines for Emergency Housing, the municipality must proactively conduct assessment of possible buildings to determine the extent they can be converted and refurbished.

TITLE: Newcastle Coal
ONE-LINER: When real thirst kicks, will it be too late?
SUMMARY: It is about the future of our water and food security. If we keep forcing farmers off their land, who is going to provide food? If the mines damage one of our largest aquifers in the country, where are we going to get water?

TITLE: Hope and Healing
ONE-LINER: Tonight on Carte Blanche bringing hope and healing to those desperate for a life without shame.
SUMMARY: Six months ago aesthetic surgeon Dr Ansua Steyn realized the need for a foundation to help those with in dire need of facial reconstructive surgery. State hospitals had waiting lists for up to 7 years and medical aids do not pay for so called cosmetic surgery.

TITLE: Franschoek Skytram
ONE-LINER: A proposed new Cable car in Franschhoek is dividing the town, as the project enters the public participation phase
SUMMARY: A proposed new Cable car in the tourist town of Franschhoek is causing a bitter divide between residents. The developers say this is the biggest private investment into Franschhoek for years, critical in a town with low skills and high unemployment.

TITLE: Trafficked: Bus Ride to Hell
ONE-LINER: We investigate cross-border human trafficking syndicates and uncover a seedy world where human beings, smuggled into SA, are treated as little more than a loaf of bread on a supermarket shelf
SUMMARY: We will send in a hidden camera to see if we can prove some of the allegations, and this insert could be part 1 of a larger investigation.

ONE-LINER: For almost 5 decades, Benny Mbotho has been the custodian of the earliest Upper Cretaceous fossil deposit known...
SUMMARY: We visit the Mzamba Petrified Forest and Fossil beds and meet the self-appointed custodian, Benny Mbotho. Benny is a self-taught expert on the wide variety of fossils that can be found on this 1km stretch of beach just around the corner from the Wild Coast Sun.

TITLE: Iris House
ONE-LINER: Living with severely disable children is extremely taxing on families. The full time care they require leaves families isolated and under extreme stress
SUMMARY: Nolo Mbolo is a mother of two autistic children, living in Site C in Khayelitsha. She spent ten years locking her children away until a community worker from Iris House coaxed her to let them in and get help.

TITLE: Buffalo City
ONE-LINER: An Eastern Cape development agency mandated to attract investors and increase economic development has come under the spotlight for a series of stalled multi-million rand projects.
SUMMARY: The Buffalo City Metropolitan Municipality in the Eastern Cape is yet another municipality in South Africa that is failing to deliver services to its residents. Sewage spills have become commonplace, potholes pepper the roads, water cuts and poor water quality.

TITLE: Dr Sylvia Earle
ONE-LINER: Arguably the world’s most renowned ocean scientists and deep sea explorer visiting the Southern Cape Coast
SUMMARY: Arguably the world’s most renowned ocean scientists and deep see explorer visiting the Southern Cape Coast in February? ‘It’s the blue heart of the planet, we should take care of our heart’ - Scuba diver, oceanographer, marine biologist, aquanaut.

TITLE: THROWFORWARD: Chasing the Sun 2
ONE-LINER: We provide a glimpse into the incredible Springbok story of transformation and victory against the odds.
SUMMARY: “Chasing the Sun 2” is a story about changing fortunes and changing mindsets, about pressure and hope, about recognizing the power of inspiration, and learning what representation truly means.

TITLE: Gqeberha Gangs
ONE-LINER: Violent house robberies have community under siege
SUMMARY: The community of Despatch, a small town just outside of Gqeberha in the Eastern Cape, sleeps with one eye open, living in fear as the notorious gang known as The Panga Gang has been terrorising them for months.

TITLE: Sgt Keshi Mabunda
ONE-LINER: Meet the cop who is putting the country's top serial killers behind bars. Sergeant Kesha Mabunda goes beyond the line of duty and is reaping the rewards.
SUMMARY: Meet Sergeant Keshi Mabunda who goes beyond the line of duty to put South Africa's top serial killers behind bars.

TITLE: Elections Guide 2024
ONE-LINER: National Elections are less than 90 days away, but are you ready to make your mark South Africa – we give you the lowdown on some of the promises being peddled.
SUMMARY: 2024 – the year of elections. Almost half the world’s population will go to the ballot boxes across about 80 countries. In South Africa, the country is at cross road – politically and economically.

TITLE: Chasing the Sun 2
ONE-LINER: From a sport defined by its past, and a country defined by its differences, comes the story of a team that chooses to believe in something more.
SUMMARY: Documentary following the Springbok journey through adversity to international victory and national pride.

TITLE: Paying for Air
ONE-LINER: Residents of the City of Joburg have for years battled crippling water outages… now, we can show that some residents are - quite literally - paying for air when the water isn’t running.
SUMMARY: I want to take our presenter with Ravin Singh to several Johannesburg suburbs (Melville, Kensington, Coronationville) to show how this overcharging is still happening when air runs through meters instead of water.

TITLE: Yolande Maritz 4
ONE-LINER: It’s been nearly 10 years since the first baby died at the hands of Yolande Maritz, and she is still practicing
SUMMARY: It’s been nearly 10 years since the first baby died (that we know about) at the hands of Yolande Maritz, and she is still practicing. How has the South African nursing council, the governing body responsible for holding her accountable, failed all these babies that have died or been damaged.

TITLE: Soccer Grannies
ONE-LINER: Granny soccer stars from Tzaneen to the world
SUMMARY: The soccer grannies of Limpopo spearheaded by the powerhouse, Mamma Beka, are making waves around the world. Last year they organised the first ever soccer granny’s world championship with teams competing from Zambia, USA, France, Zimbabwe and Mozambique.

TITLE: THROWFORWARD: Iris House
ONE-LINER: Iris House Children's Hospice offers a life-line to families living with the isolation and challenge of disabled and terminally ill children. But it is being threatened by drastic budget cuts.
SUMMARY: Iris House Children's Hospice offers a life-line to families living with the isolation and challenge of disabled and terminally ill children.

TITLE: UPDATE: Zuko Nonxuba Payouts
ONE-LINER: After years of inaction, the LPC is forced to compensate the victims of attorney, Zuko Nonxuba...
SUMMARY: A team of lawyers acting for victims of disgraced attorney Zuko Nonxuba have secured a court order giving the Legal Practice Council (LPC) strict timelines to complete its investigations into the alleged R348m plunder of his trust funds, and to pay out any proven claims.

TITLE: Msunduzi's Own Goal
ONE-LINER: Shawn Mkhize and the Royal AM Football Club multi-million sponsorship controversy
SUMMARY: Msunduzi or Pietermaritzburg is like many municipalities in South Africa, bankrupt and under administration because of poor budget control and lack of essential services, yet spends millions sponsoring Royal AM.

TITLE: PetroSA 2
ONE-LINER: He has bought and sold a soccer club, he owns multimillion rand homes in the best suburbs... Meet Shumani Lawrence
SUMMARY: Now Lawrence Mulaudzi is set to become South Africa’s new gas oligarch- thanks to state owned company PetroSA who have chosen his company Equator Holdings, as the preferred supplier to both fund and rehabilitate a multimillion rand overhaul of their gas infrastructure.

TITLE: Antarctica: Ground Zero
ONE-LINER: ... could Antarctica hold the key to saving the world from itself?
SUMMARY: Researching the climatic records and environmental changes locked in the Antarctic ice sheets to assess global warming impacts.

TITLE: Dodgy Discovery Contractors
ONE-LINER: Discovery - largest insurance company in South Africa using substandard contractors on household claims
SUMMARY: According to the Fire Protection Association of South Africa 5368 household fires occurred in 2021 and 2022. Discovery Insurance clients face severe substandard work and negligence from approved contractors.

TITLE: Knysna Collapse
ONE-LINER: Once the jewel in the crown of the Garden Route, the town of Knysna has fallen into a state of complete collapse.
SUMMARY: The Knysna estuary is the most biodiverse estuary in the country. It is where the only endemic species of seahorse can be found in South Africa. Although a popular swimming and fishing spot, swimming was banned due to raw sewage pollution.

TITLE: Shamwari Vultures
ONE-LINER: A lifeline for some of Southern Africa's most endangered vultures...
SUMMARY: Vulpro is synonymous with vulture conservation. For over a decade they have been breeding and rehabilitating vultures, releasing these birds to supplement dwindling populations in the wild. Now expanding to Shamwari.

TITLE: UPDATE: Rally Rookies
ONE-LINER: An extraordinary school offers pupils the chance to pursue a career in motorsports... now it has been recognised with an award.
SUMMARY: The award honours the top FIA Member Organisation for its outstanding commitment to the implementation of diverse and inclusive practices and activities that foster equitable, sustainable, and measurable change.

TITLE: Shipping Shambles
ONE-LINER: DISRUPTIONS IN WORLD TRADE triggered by war create a golden opportunity for South Africa to boost its own economy - but ironically it’s an opportunity the country is missing out on.
SUMMARY: In any war there is collateral damage, direct and indirect economic impact and ironically even opportunities for some to benefit. Right now, global trade is being disrupted as attacks in the Red Sea hots up, with shipping companies rerouting around the Cape of Good Hope.

TITLE: Herf Street 22
ONE-LINER: If someone acted, two year old Chevonne Rusch may still have been alive.
SUMMARY: Verdict has finally been made in the Chevonne Rusch trial. Her mother together with her former boyfriend Stephan van Niekerk are guilty of murder. The mother, Rochelle Botha has further been found guilty on cases of severe child neglect, abuse, and trafficking.

TITLE: MIA 2023
ONE-LINER: Registration for Riaan Manser's Antarctica expeditions is now open.
SUMMARY: Riaan Manser, an experienced explorer in his fourth year of Antarctic expeditions, is extending an invitation to five South African high school students. They have the incredible opportunity to join him on a fully funded expedition to Antarctica.

SUMMARY: Profile of athletes who staged miraculous recoveries to reach peak physical performance against all odds.

TITLE: Yolande Maritz 3
ONE-LINER: The midwife killer is back

TITLE: UPDATE: Victim to Hero

SUMMARY: When a child faces an emergency such as an accident or burn injury, they are rushed to adult trauma units. CMADT establishes a dedicated paediatric trauma and emergency unit.

SUMMARY: While we only had a handful of complaints during our first story, the list has now grown to 35 cases where elderly people have lost life savings in the Steyn brothers' life rights schemes.

TITLE: Twin Reunion

SUMMARY: 77 Bird Street is a problem property that has remained an abandoned, water-filled deathtrap for 30 years, claiming young lives while council fails to act.

SUMMARY: Street children and youth dance groups using street performances at traffic intersections to escape poverty, crime, and starvation.

SUMMARY: The narrative follows a kidnapping, providing insights from the victim, the kidnapper, and hostage negotiators, exposing the terrifying rise of kidnapping syndicates in South Africa.

SITE TITLE: I'm in Love with my Chatbot

SUMMARY: Exploring the psychological, emotional, and privacy implications of AI companions and digital relationships.
